# Migration from v6 to v7

Migration guide from v6 to v7

## Overview

- **Category**: migration
- **Base Library**: custom

## About

This is a documentation page. Please refer to the [Netline UI Storybook](https://netline-ui-storybook-next.aks-netline.dev.lhsystems.int) for complete information.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { MigrationV6toV7 } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<MigrationV6toV7>
  Content
</MigrationV6toV7>
```
